despoiler-field-ranked.scope: Stock level-30, 46/60 Memory. Empty and allied selections and the 16.01 m hostile are refused before any cast, debit or reuse. The valid cast takes 6 s, pays 40 IS and starts 30 s own reuse. On the primary and the 4.00 m edge alone, 159/171 add -14 and 522/524 add -39. All eight records remove at 30 s. The 4.01 m hostile, ally and caster receive none. No damage, max-vital change or interlock.
